title: Ripple-carry bit block
statement: Given natural-number labels $a,b,c,c_{\mathrm{in}},\mathrm{acc},L$, define a gate list by concatenating the full-adder construction on $a,b,c_{\mathrm{in}}$ at label $L$, the four-gate exclusive OR construction on $L+7,c$ at label $L+9$, then a NOT gate reading $L+12$ and an AND gate reading $\mathrm{acc},L+13$.
